current_position: Grammy-winning country/hip-hop artist; 'A Bar Song (Tipsy)' spent 19 weeks at #1 on Billboard Hot 100 (tied for longest-running #1 solo artist); six Grammy nominations; won Best Country Duo/Group Performance 2025; Forbes 30 Under 30 2025 Music.

trajectory.event: Released first single 'Jeff Gordon' after moving to Los Angeles to pursue music and creative work.
Released debut album 'Lady Wrangler' on Republic Records; appeared on Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse soundtrack with 'Start a Riot' alongside Duckwrth.
Released second album 'Cowboys Live Forever, Outlaws Never Die' on Empire Records.
Featured on Beyonce's Cowboy Carter album; 'A Bar Song (Tipsy)' spent 19 weeks at #1 on Billboard Hot 100; third album 'Where I've Been, Isn't Where I'm Going' topped charts.
Won Grammy for Best Country Duo/Group Performance with Jelly Roll on 'Amen'; six Grammy nominations; Forbes 30 Under 30 Music.
